<om-film>
  <om-scene>
    <om-shot>
      <video src="media/story.mp4"></video>
      <om-vo src="audio/story.wav">
        <om-envelope in="300ms"></om-envelope>
        A precise story begins.
      </om-vo>
    </om-shot>
  </om-scene>
</om-film>

<om-film>
  <om-music src="audio/theme.wav" gain="20%">
    <om-envelope in="1s" out="1s"></om-envelope>
  </om-music>
  <om-scene>
    <om-shot>
      <video src="media/demo.mp4"></video>
      <om-vo src="audio/demo-voice.wav">
        <om-envelope in="150ms" out="250ms"></om-envelope>
        Watch the system respond.
      </om-vo>
      <om-sfx src="audio/click.wav" gain="50%" delay="600ms">
        <om-envelope in="50ms" out="100ms"></om-envelope>
      </om-sfx>
    </om-shot>
  </om-scene>
</om-film>

<om-film>
  <om-scene>
    <om-shot>
      <video src="media/answer.mp4"></video>
      <om-vo src="audio/answer.wav" delay="100ms">
        <om-envelope in="200ms" out="400ms"></om-envelope>
        The answer stays exact.
      </om-vo>
    </om-shot>
  </om-scene>
</om-film>

<om-film>
  <om-scene>
    <om-shot>
      <video src="media/controls.mp4"></video>
      <om-sfx src="audio/click.wav" delay="100ms">
        <om-envelope in="20ms"></om-envelope>
      </om-sfx>
      <om-sfx src="audio/chime.wav" delay="700ms">
        <om-envelope out="200ms"></om-envelope>
      </om-sfx>
    </om-shot>
  </om-scene>
</om-film>

<om-film>
  <om-scene>
    <om-shot>
      <video src="media/first.mp4"></video>
      <om-vo src="audio/first.wav">
        <om-envelope out="180ms"></om-envelope>
        First thought.
      </om-vo>
    </om-shot>
    <om-shot>
      <video src="media/second.mp4"></video>
      <om-vo src="audio/second.wav">
        <om-envelope in="220ms"></om-envelope>
        Second thought.
      </om-vo>
    </om-shot>
  </om-scene>
</om-film>
